Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 59 s. 2023 SEP 12 HON. JONATHAN P. FRUTO Punong Barangay Barangay Mabilo II, Municipality of Labo Province of Camarines Norte Dear PB Fruto: This has reference to your undated letter which we received on June 5, 2023, seeking legal opinion from this Department on whether or not the current Sangguniang Panlalawigan may validly revoke a perfected Deed of Donation by the previous Sangguniang Panlalawigan and accordingly, the donee shall be compelled to return the vehicle subject of the previous donation. Per your representation, the Provincial Government of Camarines Norte donated a vehicle to Barangay Mabilo II on June 28, 2022, with the authorization of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, which you accepted as the Punong Barangay. You stated that the donation was perfected and certified by a Sangguniang Panlalawigan Resolution granting permission to Governor Edgardo A. Tallado and a Deed of Donation approved and signed on June 29, 2022. You further claimed that the barangay was using the car to serve its residents. However, on May 31, 2023, you received a letter from the Provincial Legal Office of the Province of Camarines Norte requiring you to return the said given vehicle, stating that the authority to donate the vehicle had been revoked by the new Sangguniang Panlalawigan. Per the letter from the Provincial Legal Office of the Province of Camarines Norte, the Commission on Audit (COA) issued Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) No. 23-022 finding that the manner by which the vehicle donated was not in consonance with the pertinent provisions of COA Circular No. 92-386, thereby rendering the transaction irregular. Thus, your request for legal opinion. At the outset, please be informed that this Department is precluded from acting on queries which are cognizable by other agencies of the government. Considering that the Commission on Audit has already issued an Audit Observation Memorandum, rendering the transaction irregular, the Department is precluded from taking any action herewith. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

To further opine on the validity or invalidity of the revocation by the present Sangguniang Panlalawigan of a perfected Deed of Donation by the previous Sangguniang Panlalawigan would be tantamount to interfering on the right of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to rectify the AOM issued by the COA. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BY UTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: N CTOR R.
